text:
maria: quick flag — after yesterday's routing tweak (priority-aging), /generate-route p95 briefly climbed ~95ms around 18:06 UTC. p50 looks unchanged. Canary gating showed the bump. anyone seen this in traces?

alex: I noticed the same on the rollout strip. Live traces point at longer queue waits for mid/low-priority traffic. Might be preemption + batch fragmentation.

jin: I ran a short probe. Query used:
```
SELECT priority_bucket, phase, percentile(lat_ms,95) p95, count(*) samples
FROM route_traces
WHERE endpoint = '/generate-route' AND ts >= now() - interval '4 hours'
GROUP BY priority_bucket, phase
```
Output: high-pri queue p95 ~72ms (samples 140k), med-pri queue p95 ~190ms (12k), low-pri queue p95 ~360ms (3.6k). Compute-phase p95s are ~60-85ms across buckets. So queue phase is the dominant delta.

sam: Interesting that overall p99 barely moved; smells like a cohort shift (mid-tail) rather than a true tail regression. Also check whether our sampler for canary traffic overindexes slow debug clients — that would exaggerate p95.

lia: there is a fallback to variant-b when queue_depth > 900. variant-b is slightly slower for some payload shapes (+70-100ms). audit logs show more variant-b hits during the window.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: snapshot uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/telemetry/snapshots/4827651200 (includes rollup CSV and sample trace IDs)

alex: two immediate console ideas: (1) make "phase-aware" percentiles first-class (queue_wait vs service_time) on endpoint pages; (2) show sample_count + a confidence flag next to every percentile so small-sample p95s are obvious. Right now the merged percentile masks changes in phase mix.

maria: yes — and annotate dashboards with the routing-config deploy (PR #3872) timestamp so metric deltas can be correlated without digging into logs. small note saves time.

jin: i'll prototype rollup keys: add `phase` + `priority_bucket` to the per-minute rollups and emit samples. example rollup snippet:
```
SELECT phase, priority_bucket, percentile(lat_ms,95) p95, count(*) samples
FROM telemetry.rollups
WHERE endpoint='/generate-route' AND window='1m'
GROUP BY phase, priority_bucket
```
Prelim results match my probe: queue p95(low) >> compute p95(low).

sam: also please add a sampling-skew check in ingestion: if the canary sampler is non-uniform or if a small subset of trace sources dominates slow samples, we should flag it and attach provenance.

lia: UX suggestion: in the endpoint breakdown hover show compact p50/p95/p99 split by phase using tiny stacked bars (queue vs compute). includes sample_count tooltip. super helpful for quick triage.

maria: filing a short ticket: add phase-aware percentiles + sample_count/confidence badge + deploy annotation on the route page. also default the latency pane to phase view for endpoints that report queueing. who wants query/rollup work?

alex: i'll take dashboard wiring and deploy annotation integration (add PR link + commit id).

jin: i'll update rollup ingestion to include phase and priority dims, and implement a low-sample confidence flag (eg samples < 500 -> low confidence). will also export trace_ids for the slow cohort.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: created INF-12901 "Phase-aware latency + sample confidence + deploy pins" and attached a mock of the hover tooltip.

sam: one more ask — when we show combined total latency, make it an explicit aggregate view and surface phase-split by default for queueing endpoints. reduces false alarms when mixing phases shifts p95.

maria: agreed. after the changes land let's re-run the canary gating and compare med/low-pri queue p95 before/after. if queue_wait remains high we can tune aging windows or raise fallback hysteresis. thanks all for quick triage.
